assertions.subject: Cyanotic congenital heart disease
assertions.quote: Other causes of papilledema are cyanotic congenital heart disease

assertions.subject: Oligodendrogliomas
assertions.quote: The mechanism of papilledema that on rare occasions accompanies spinal tumors, particularly oligodendrogliomas

assertions.subject: Guillain-Barré syndrome
assertions.quote: The mechanism of papilledema that on rare occasions accompanies spinal tumors, particularly oligodendrogliomas, and the Guillain-Barré syndrome

assertions.subject: Chronic lung disease with hypercapnia
assertions.quote: In other diseases that at times give rise to papilledema—e.g., chronic lung disease with hypercapnia

assertions.subject: Cancer with meningeal infiltration
assertions.quote: In other diseases that at times give rise to papilledema—e.g., chronic lung disease with hypercapnia, cancer with meningeal infiltration

assertions.subject: Dural arteriovenous malformation
assertions.quote: In other diseases that at times give rise to papilledema—e.g., chronic lung disease with hypercapnia, cancer with meningeal infiltration, or dural arteriovenous malformation

assertions.subject: Polycythemia
assertions.quote: Other causes of papilledema are cyanotic congenital heart disease, and other forms of polycythemia

assertions.subject: POEMS syndrome
assertions.quote: Other causes of papilledema are cyanotic congenital heart disease, and other forms of polycythemia, hypocalcemia though an obscure mechanism, and POEMS syndrome
